settings.heading: Meet With Us Face to Face
settings.text:
Planning gifts for your employees, clients, partners, or an upcoming event? Schedule a complimentary in-person consultation in the Dallas–Fort Worth area.

We’ll discuss your gifting needs, timeline, quantities, and personalization options. You’ll also receive a complimentary pen engraved with your name or company logo as a sample of our work.
settings.fine_print: Visits are arranged by appointment. We will confirm the meeting details with you.
settings.photo_note: Реальное фото Дарьи/места встречи и персонализированной ручки-образца.

settings.question: Can I order just one gift?
settings.answer: Yes. We handle orders from 1 to 5,000+ units. Tell us the product and quantity so we can confirm pricing and availability.

settings.question: Can I see a mockup or sample first?
settings.answer: Request a free custom mockup before ordering. Physical samples and in-person sample reviews are available for qualifying projects. Ask about a sample.

settings.question: How quickly can you engrave my order?
settings.answer: Small orders can be ready in as little as 1 business day; up to 1,000 engraved pens can be produced in 1 business day. Turnaround time varies by product, quantity, design complexity, artwork approval, and inventory availability. Production timing does not include shipping.

settings.question: Can we meet in Dallas?
settings.answer: Yes. Request an in-person consultation at 18383 Preston Rd, #202, Dallas, TX 75252. We will confirm availability. You’ll receive a complimentary personalized pen at the meeting.
